Pass 2 combines the table copy, the Change link and the per-species unfinished messages: all are the identification part of a species block. req-879 is the live-animals half only: the 9 October ruling (claim 57) split out the germinal wording (req-1841), which the germinal set's review row builds. These messages are about a missing count or no identifier at all, so the one-identifier rule (claim 188) does not change them.

increments.title: Each uploaded document has its own card on the review, showing its file name
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 gives every uploaded document its own 'Document <n>' card with its own Change link, shows the attached file's name rather than its type, and shows a single 'Not applicable' card when nothing is uploaded. Today all documents share one card.
acceptanceCriteria: Each uploaded document has its own card in '4. Uploaded documents', titled 'Document <n>', whose header Change link opens the documents page, at the address it has today, and on saving returns to the review (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-104, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-105; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-150, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-156; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-077, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-078)

Each document card shows 'Document reference', 'Document type', 'Date of issue' and 'Attachment', where Attachment is the uploaded file's name (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-104; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-150)

With no documents uploaded, '4. Uploaded documents' shows a single 'Document 1' card whose 'Document reference' reads 'Not applicable', and the words 'You have not added any documents yet.' no longer appear (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-106)
notes: Depends on the row 'Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages' (section 4's name). Kept as its own row because it owns only the documents card and builds in parallel with the other card rows. The tests repo asserts today's empty-state sentence and follows the new card. Virus-scan errors on the review stay (c-140).

increments.title: Addresses card: permanent addresses, CPH format, one header link and a single unfinished entry
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 shows pets' permanent addresses in full in the Addresses card, writes the CPH with slashes, gives the Addresses and Contact address cards one header Change link and no row actions (c-138), returns a CPH change made from the review to the review (c-141, settling DR1 parity row inc-146's open question), and lists one error summary entry per unfinished card, so a deleted saved address is named once, on its card (c-135).
acceptanceCriteria: In the live-animals set, pets' permanent addresses read back in the Addresses card as a 'Permanent address' subsection, one entry per animal labelled '<common name> <n>' (for example 'Domestic cat 1') with the full address and 'United Kingdom', without email or phone, and the identification table has no Permanent address column (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-111; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-152, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-153)
The CPH number reads back with its parts separated by slashes, for example '12/345/6789' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-160, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-154)

No party row and no contact address row carries an 'Edit details' link: the Addresses and Contact address cards' header Change links are their only links (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-067; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-151; c-138)
A party whose copied address breaks the address-book rules still has an error summary entry linking to its edit page (c-138; c-139)

A trader who changes the CPH number from the Addresses card is returned to the review after saving, not sent onward through the journey (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-109, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-110; c-141)

When the consignor's saved address has been deleted, the error summary holds the single entry 'Complete roles and addresses' linking to the Addresses card, and 'Select an address for the consignor' shows on the consignor's row inside the card, with no separate consignor entry in the summary; the full error list for this case is pinned by a test (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-043; c-135)
notes: Depends on the row 'Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages' (the Addresses and Contact address cards) and on inc-054 as before. Pass 2 combines the Addresses card's read-back slices (permanent addresses, CPH) with its link and error-summary slices (row actions, CPH return, deleted address): all change the same card and its errors. Moving the permanent address out of the identification table touches that table too; the identification row owns the table's other columns. The CPH page's own return behaviour may need the change context the CPH page reads, which is another theme's page: a shared change. The tests repo's page object clicks 'Edit details' today and follows the header link. req-848 is the live-animals set's only: the germinal set's review has no Permanent address subsection and no CPH row (req-1843).

increments.title: The review page reads each party's copied address back as name, address lines and country, in live animals and plants
increments.detail: The trader checks the address copy the notification holds before submitting. Design Release 2.1 reads each consignment party and the contact address back as the name followed by the address lines and the country, each on its own line, with no telephone number or email address. Today the animals review shows each copy as a block with the name in bold and every non-empty field, telephone and email included; plants' check-answers party cards (place of destination, consignor and contact) have Name, Address, Telephone number and Email address rows, with the address joined by commas on one line. The 9 October afternoon ruling (c-293) makes plants change the same way in the same increment. The address-book record still carries both. Observable in each frontend's fit suite, on the compose stack and in CDP.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live-animals review page each consignment party with an address reads back as its name, then each non-empty address line, town or city and postcode, then the country, each on its own line (trace:e2e p8-004, p8-005; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-001)
A country of GB reads back as 'United Kingdom' (trace:e2e p8-004; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-001)
No party's telephone number or email address appears in the live-animals review page's read-back (repo:tests p5-040, p5-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-001)
The contact address for the consignment reads back the same way: name, address lines, country, with no telephone number or email address (trace:e2e p8-018)
On the plants check-answers page the place of destination, consignor and contact cards have no 'Telephone number' or 'Email address' row (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-031, p3-045; conflicts:c-293)

On the plants check-answers page each of those cards reads the address back one address line per line, followed by the country on its own line, instead of joined by commas on one line (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-031, p3-045)
notes: Unchanged in substance from the last distil. This draft cites only this area's claims; the existing inc-109 also cites the prototype and plants repo claims (prototype:dr2-1-source p11-065, p11-114; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-160, p13-151, p13-155; repo:plantsfrontend p8-024, p8-059) from other areas' working sets: combiner, keep them, but cite no claim c-293 overrules. Plants' d-013 contact telephone and email rows are overruled by c-293. The end-to-end specs that read every copied field back from the review page (copied addresses, submit freeze, address edit) change with the read-back. The review page's party cards are the overview-and-review theme's code; plants' check-answers view-model must be in that theme's touches too. Does not touch the split-off templates theme's template-review view-model. Depends on inc-101.

increments.title: Review ends with Continue and Delete, and an amendment's review offers Cancel amend and tells the trader they are re-submitting
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 ends an editable review with Continue and a red Delete. While amending, it adds a 'Cancel amend' button, retitles the review 'Review before re-submitting' once something has changed, and opens with no errors shown. The ruling's validation override still refuses an incomplete resubmission and says why (c-136). The buttons reuse the shared notification actions wording as it reads today. Plants' check answers takes the same end buttons and amend behaviour in the same increment, keeping its own wording. What the delete and cancel-amend confirmations do is the manage-notifications area's.
acceptanceCriteria: An editable journey or draft review ends with 'Continue' and, beside it, a red 'Delete' button that opens the notification's delete confirmation, reading 'Delete' as the shared notification actions wording reads today (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-115, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-118; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-162, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-157; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-084; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-068, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)

While a notification is being amended, the review ends with 'Continue', which submits, a secondary 'Cancel amend' button that opens the cancel-amendment confirmation, and a red 'Delete' button that opens the delete confirmation; there is no 'Cancel amendment' link (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-117; c-189)

An amendment's review is headed and titled 'Review your notification' when first opened, and 'Review before re-submitting' once any notification answer differs from the submitted version (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-019)

Changing only the uploaded documents during an amendment leaves the heading 'Review your notification', because only notification answers count as a change (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-019)
An amendment's review opens with no error summary and no card errors, even when answers are missing (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-040, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-041; c-136)

Pressing Continue on an amendment that is not complete does not submit it: the review is shown again with its error summary naming what is missing (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-041; c-136)

On a high-risk plants draft's editable check answers, a red warning button with plants' existing 'Delete notification' wording sits beside Continue and opens the notification's delete page; Save and return and the Cancel link stay (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-046; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-043, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-044, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-051)

While a plants notification is being amended, check answers offers 'Cancel amend' as a secondary button beside Continue that opens the cancel-amendment confirmation, in place of the 'Cancel amendment' link under the heading, and shows no delete button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-046; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-055)

A plants amendment's check answers opens with no error summary and no errors; Continue on an incomplete amendment does not submit it, and the page shown again names what is missing (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-028, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-046; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-038, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-039; c-136)
notes: Pass 2 combines the review's end actions with the amendment review's heading and error behaviour: all are the review's own controls and state, with the same amend set-up. The backend already keeps a pre-amend snapshot of the notification separately from its documents; telling the frontend whether the notification answers differ from it is the backend part of this slice. Delete reuses the shared notification actions wording 'Delete' as it reads today; any different wording goes in the review's own copy, never the shared copy (afternoon ruling, claims p2-067 to p2-069). The tests repo asserts today that a draft review has no Delete, and the cancel-amend spec uses the 'Cancel amendment' link; both follow. Delete and cancel-amend confirmations belong to manage-notifications; this row only links to them ('Cancel amend' only leads to a confirmation, so it is a link styled as a button, c-189).

req-1991 to req-1993 (plants' review end buttons and amend review) sit here under the afternoon ruling's same-increment rule (claims p3-013 and p3-046). Plants' heading for changed answers is left out: plants' backend does not yet send that signal (claim p3-047).

increments.title: A submitted notification's view has a header: reference, status, date submitted and a Back link to the set's own notification list
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 heads a submitted notification's view with its reference and status, dates it, and gives it a Back link. The 9 October ruling keys the header on the real route and the stored status and keeps dashboard draft rows going to the hub; the afternoon ruling sends the Back link, and an unknown notification, to the set's own notification list in the animals frontend (c-143, c-198) and draws the header in the set's own review template with the shared status strip switched off, leaving the shared layout unchanged. This row builds the header for Submitted, Submitted action required and Completed; the draft's own header at the same review route (c-246) is the row after the header actions, because it reuses them. The page title keeps the page name before the service, as accessibility requires (c-006). Plants' read-only view takes the same header in the same increment.
acceptanceCriteria: A submitted notification's view shows its notification reference as the h1 in place of 'Review your notification', with its status beside it as a tag reading 'Submitted', and no status strip above it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-179, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-173; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-067, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-090; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-096; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-060, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-061, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-062)

A submitted notification's view has the page title '<reference> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', while the journey review of a draft or an amendment keeps 'Review your notification - Import notification service - GOV.UK' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-173; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p25-002; c-006)

Under the header, a submitted notification's view shows 'Date submitted: <d Month yyyy>', the date it was submitted as stored on the notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-023, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-024; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-092, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-102)

A submitted live-animals notification's view has a Back link to the live-animals notification list, the set's own list in the animals frontend (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-016; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-021; c-143; c-198)

Opening the view of a notification that does not exist goes to the set's own notification list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-002, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-007; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-063, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101; c-198)

A submitted high-risk plants notification's read-only view has the notification reference as its heading, with its status as a tag beside it, in place of 'Check your answers', and no shared status strip above it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-048, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-060, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-061; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-003, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-050)

That plants view's browser title starts with the notification reference, before the service name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-048; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-003)

Under its header the plants view shows 'Date submitted: <d Month yyyy>' from the notification's stored submission date (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-048; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-050, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-082)

The plants view's Back link goes to plants' own notification list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-048, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-101; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-005; c-143)
notes: The Back link and the missing-notification redirect go to the set's own notification list in the animals frontend (the live-animals set root for live animals; the germinal set's copy of the review points at the germinal set root) (afternoon ruling claim p3-101; c-143, c-198). Because the destination is in the same frontend, every criterion is observable in the fit run, on the workspace stack and in CDP alike, with no configured URL. The header is drawn in the set's own review template with the shared strip switched off (journeyStrip: null); the shared layout is not changed (afternoon ruling, claims p2-060 to p2-062). The not-found case stays caught in the review's controller (claim p2-063). Pass 2 combines the view header (reference, status, title, date submitted) with its navigation (Back link, missing notification): one page state, one set-up. The backend already stores the submitted date but the view data carries only the created date; returning the submitted date is the backend part. Status tags for 'Submitted action required' and 'Submission complete'/'Completed' are the action-required and completed rows'. 'Copy as new', 'Delete' and 'Amend this notification' in the header are the header-actions row's.
req-1995 to req-1998 (plants' submitted view header) sit here under the afternoon ruling's same-increment rule (claims p3-013 and p3-048).
increments.gate: Look at how the page tells a submitted notification's view from the journey review (keyed on the route and stored status), at the view header drawn in the set's own template with the status strip off, and at the Back link to the set's own list: the header-actions, action-required, draft-header and completed rows all build on this header.

increments.title: View header offers Amend, Copy as new and Delete, and shows the import reference numbers as text to copy
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 offers 'Amend this notification' on a submitted notification, 'Copy as new' and 'Delete' on every submitted notification's view, and gives the trader the notification reference and customs document code they need for the customs declaration. Each state-changing control looks as Design Release 2.1 draws it but submits a form with the CSRF token (c-189), and the buttons reuse the shared notification actions wording as it reads today. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the import reference numbers now as selectable text, without the prototype's JavaScript-only Copy buttons, which wait on design as their own requirement (c-294). Plants' view takes Amend, Delete and the reference section in the same increment, without Copy as new, which plants has parked. What amend, copy and delete do is the manage-notifications area's.
acceptanceCriteria: A Submitted notification's view header shows a primary 'Amend this notification' button, and a draft's review shows none (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-097, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-103)

A submitted notification's view header always offers 'Copy as new': a secondary button beside 'Amend this notification' when that shows, otherwise the primary button (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-098; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-068; c-189)

A submitted notification's view header always shows a red 'Delete' warning button that opens the notification's delete confirmation (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-068)

A submitted notification's view shows an 'Import reference numbers' section with the warning 'You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.', a 'Notification reference' row with the reference and a 'Customs document code' row reading 'C640' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-035, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-036, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-093, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-094; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-180, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-176; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-073; c-294)

Each import reference value is shown as plain text the trader can select and copy, with JavaScript on or off, and neither row shows a 'Copy' button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-073, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-074; c-294)

The header of a submitted plants notification's view shows a primary 'Amend this notification' button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-049; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-050)

The plants view's header shows the red warning 'Delete notification' button leading to the delete page, which no longer sits at the foot of the view, and the view offers no 'Copy as new' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-049, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-050; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-051)

The plants view shows an 'Import reference numbers' section with the warning 'You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.' and a 'Notification reference' row with the reference as text the trader can select; it has no 'Customs document code' row and no Copy buttons (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-024, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-049, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-051; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-050, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-080; c-294)

notes: Depends on the row 'A submitted notification's view has a header…'. Pass 2 combines the header's three action buttons with the import reference numbers section: all sit in the view header under the same set-up. The section is built now with selectable text (afternoon ruling claim p1-073, c-294); the Copy buttons are req-1986, its own increment in the waiting-on-design theme, blocked until design answers (claim p1-074). Copy as new and Delete reuse the shared notification actions wording as it reads today (claims p2-067 and p2-068); any different wording goes in the review's own copy. req-896 to req-898 name the submitted statuses; c-246 also puts Copy as new, Delete and the Import reference numbers on a draft's review, which the draft-header row builds on top of this row. Copy as new submits a form (c-189); 'Amend this notification' only leads to a confirmation, so it is a link styled as a button. The Submitted action required and Completed states' buttons are checked in their own rows.

req-1999 to req-2001 (plants' view header actions and import reference numbers) sit here under the afternoon ruling's same-increment rule (claims p3-013 and p3-049). Plants' customs document code row waits in its own blocked row (req-2002). The Copy buttons wait in the waiting-on-design row (req-1986).

increments.title: Submitting records its date and outstanding items, and a notification still missing its health certificate shows as 'Submitted action required'
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 records the submission date and what is still outstanding at the declaration, and shows a notification submitted without its health certificate as 'Submitted action required': read-only, with a warning saying what to do, the missing certificate marked in section 4, and a Continue that leads back to the hub. The real service can only change a submitted notification through an amendment, so that Continue starts one (c-144). How action-required is stored is the real service's design. The afternoon ruling adds 'Submitted action required' as a new status beside the others, maps it in the animals frontend and the INS dashboard's links before the animals backend sends it, on one branch name, and keeps it animals only because it rests on the ITAHC. The identifier-driven items are a separate row. Notification statuses are only ever added, never renamed or removed: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AMEND and DELETED stay as they are. 'Submitted action required', which inc-113's submit records, is added beside them. The animals frontend throws on a status it does not know, and the INS dashboard sends only SUBMITTED notifications to the review, so each new status is mapped in the animals frontend (its persistence records, its real status mapping, the stub and the status strip's copy) and in the INS dashboard's notification links before the animals backend first sends it, on one branch name shared by the animals backend, the animals frontend and the INS frontend. The status rests on the ITAHC, so plants does not take it.
acceptanceCriteria: After declaring and submitting, the notification's view shows 'Date submitted: <the day it was submitted>', and the same date on every later visit (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-145, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-155; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-098)

A notification submitted with no uploaded ITAHC or health certificate is shown from then on with the status tag 'Submitted action required'; one submitted with an ITAHC or health certificate shows 'Submitted' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-006, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-011; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-090)

The action-required view is read-only and its header carries a GOV.UK warning text reading 'You need to upload a health certificate' when the ITAHC is the only outstanding item (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-033, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-034; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-091)

On an action-required notification with no uploaded document, '4. Uploaded documents' shows the error 'Upload a valid health certificate' in place of document cards, inline, with no error summary (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-107; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-099)

The action-required view ends with 'Continue', which starts an amendment of the notification and opens its hub, where the trader can upload the certificate (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-120; c-144)

The action-required view header offers 'Amend this notification', 'Copy as new' and 'Delete' as a Submitted notification's does (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-027, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-029)

increments.title: Amend goes through a confirmation page, then opens the amend review, in animals and plants
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 asks a trader to confirm before amending a submitted notification, then takes them straight to the notification's review page so they can see and change their answers. Today the card's Amend is a form button that starts the amendment straight away and lands on the overview hub, one step away from the review; plants' card Amend does the same. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps the confirmation as a separate page at the notification's own amend route, carrying the pop-up's wording as page content, with no pop-up (c-190; the pop-up waits on design in its own row). Every way into an amendment goes through it: 'Amend this notification' on the view page and the card's Amend become links to it (c-310), and its 'Yes, continue' is a form post with the CSRF crumb (c-189). Confirming lands on the amend review. An amend that cannot happen returns the trader to the set's own notification list (c-198). Plants gets the same page, landing on plants' own review page, and its refused amend goes to plants' own list. The k6 amendment journey moves with the landing (c-225).

increments.title: Card status styles on both lists, and 'Action required' on the set's own list for a submitted notification missing its ITAHC
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 flags a submitted notification still missing its ITAHC on the dashboard card. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds this on the set's own notification list in the animals frontend, read from the animals backend's record of the 'Submitted action required' state (c-149), not on the INS read model. How the INS 'Action needed' count and drill-down learn of it waits on the INS dashboard's requirements. Design Release 2.1 uses a tag only for statuses that ask something of the trader. A draft shows a 'Draft' tag and an action-required notification an 'Action required' tag, while 'Submitted' is plain styled text. Plants' card follows the same styles for Draft and Submitted and keeps its 'Late' tag; 'Action required' is animals only, because it rests on the health certificate.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live-animals notification list, a submitted notification with no uploaded ITAHC or health certificate shows an 'Action required' tag on an error card, with a red marker hidden from assistive technology, and 'ITAHC is missing' as plain text under its reference (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-148, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-150; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-085, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-017; c-149)

A submitted notification with an ITAHC or health certificate uploaded shows no 'Action required' tag and no 'ITAHC is missing' text on the list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-148; c-149)

Once the missing certificate is uploaded through an amendment and the notification is re-submitted, the list stops showing 'Action required' for it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-150; c-144; c-149)

On the live animals list a draft's 'Notification status' is a 'Draft' tag. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-062; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-067; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-090)

increments.title: Action needed drill-down lists the organisation's notifications needing action
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 adds an 'Action needed' page, reached from each category's Action needed card, listing the notifications the trader must act on: a submitted notification still missing a required document, or with no animal identifier where one is required, recorded by the animals backend as 'Submitted action required' (c-149). The INS front door lists those notifications at /actions, across every category or only the one it is showing, scoped to the signed-in organisation, with Design Release 2.1's intro block, a results line, 8 a page and the category list's card (c-154). Sam's 9 October rulings block it as INS dashboard summary information; how the action-required state and the category reach the INS read model is settled when the area is re-distilled.
acceptanceCriteria: The Action needed drill-down is served by the INS front door at /actions with the browser title 'Tasks requiring your attention - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Action needed', the h1 'Tasks requiring your attention' and the description 'Add missing information or upload documents to prevent your consignment from being delayed.', laid out in Design Release 2.1's intro block rather than as a GOV.UK caption and heading (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11708-11710; app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:34-36; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:153-159; conflicts:c-156)

A live-animals notification submitted without its ITAHC or health certificate is listed with an 'Action required' status tag and the message 'ITAHC is missing'; once the certificate is uploaded and the notification re-submitted it is no longer listed (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 14-16; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p15-087; conflicts:c-149)

A submitted notification with its certificate but a species that needs identifiers and has none identified is listed with 'Information is missing'; once one identifier is filled for each record it is no longer listed (prototype:dr2-1-source p11-149; conflicts:c-149)
A draft notification, and a submitted one with every required document and identifier, are never listed (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; conflicts:c-149)

A trader signed in for one organisation never sees another organisation's notifications on the drill-down, and a fresh organisation with none sees 'Show 0 of 0 results' (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-068; trace:ins-fit trace-ins-fit-p4-046)

Shown with no category, the drill-down lists action-needed notifications of every category; shown for live animals it lists only live-animals ones, a notification with no stored category counting as live animals; an unrecognised category lists every category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:6745-6747, 9027-9028; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:162-169; conflicts:c-296)

The page's 'Back' link goes to the live animals notification list at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend when it is showing live animals, and to the home when it is showing every category, including for an unrecognised category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:12-24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:156, 167; conflicts:c-250, c-295)

The list sits under a visually hidden h2 'Notifications needing action', preceded by 'Show 1-8 of <total> results', or 'Show 0 of 0 results' when there are none; with more than 8 the list shows 8 a page, and following a page link keeps the sort and the category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-89; app/routes.js:6630-6688, 9050; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:160-161)

Each listed notification shows the same card as the live animals list, with its status tag, its error message and its status-driven links rather than a fixed 'Copy as new' and 'View' pair (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 15-16; document:dr1-parity-notes inc-030; conflicts:c-154)

The page shows no 'Create new' or 'Use template' button, no glance cards, no Additional filters, no tabs and no Today / Next 3 days / Already delayed filter, and a delayFilter query changes nothing (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:9022-9023, 9043-9045)
The service navigation's 'Dashboard' item is marked current on the drill-down (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:8876, 9063; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-076)

With the front door's stub mode on (never in production), the drill-down lists the built-in stub's notifications; otherwise it reads them from ins-backend, and ins-backend's log for the read carries the page request's trace id (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-062, p1-063)

If the read model cannot be loaded, the drill-down still shows its intro, shows the recoverable error message, responds with HTTP status 500 and logs the failure; with Welsh selected its copy is shown in Welsh, marked as a machine draft; it has no serious or critical axe violations against the WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA tags (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-058, p1-079, p1-086)

Who: whoever owns the INS dashboard's requirements (the rulings do not name them) must firm them up and agree them with Sam.
notes: Combines the Action needed page, its list rule, the organisation scoping and the read-model request (req-1019, req-1022): the page is the first INS list the home leads to, so they cannot be observed apart.

Depends on the rows that record the action-required state on the animals backend's record (inc-131 for the missing ITAHC, inc-147 for missing identifiers). The category comes from the animals backend's notification record, absent meaning live animals; how it reaches the read model is the re-distil's to settle (c-296), so the animals backend may join repos then.

The germinal products half of req-987's Back rule is observed in the Germinal products section row; the Status updated drill-down's Back link and current navigation item are observed in that blocked row. The Inspection required half of req-990, req-992 and req-994 is proven in that blocked row.

increments.title: Search and sort the Action needed list
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1's Action needed page has a 'Search by' box and a 'Sort by:' select, but the prototype applies neither. A search and sort over real data is behaviour the seeded prototype cannot express, so the real page applies both (c-155): the search matches a notification's number, commodity, consignee or consignor, and the sort is always applied, newest first by default, with no unsorted state (c-157). The form's field and parameter names are the INS service's own. Blocked with the drill-down it searches.
acceptanceCriteria: The Action needed drill-down has a search form on its own page with a 'Search by' field and the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'; a search made while it shows only live animals stays within live animals (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-87; trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14, action 25; conflicts:c-250)

Searching for part of a listed notification's number, its commodity, its consignee's name or its consignor's name lists only the notifications that match; a search with surrounding spaces finds the same notifications, and a blank search lists them all (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-015; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-081; conflicts:c-155)
A search that matches nothing shows 'Show 0 of 0 results' (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:7644-7658)

The 'Sort by:' select offers 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', with 'Newest first' selected by default and no 'Select one' option; choosing each and pressing the form's button re-orders the list accordingly, and changing the select alone submits nothing, so the page works without JavaScript (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; document:dr1-parity-notes inc-031; conflicts:c-155, c-157)
Page links keep the chosen sort, the search and the category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-87; trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 25)
With Welsh selected, the search label, hint, sort label and options are shown in Welsh, marked as machine drafts (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-086)
openQuestions: Blocked: Sam's 9 October rulings block the INS dashboard's summary information, naming the Action needed drill-down's search and sort (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-059), until its requirements firm up and are agreed; the area is then re-distilled. Who: whoever owns the INS dashboard's requirements (the rulings do not name them) must firm them up and agree them with Sam.
notes: Kept apart from the Action needed page row so that row stays reviewable and because this one changes what the read model stores (consignee and consignor) and how it searches.
The same search form, sort select and results line are reused by the blocked Inspection required drill-down, which proves its own half of req-990, req-992 and req-994.

The Live animals section gets its Action needed card, counted from the same set its drill-down lists for the signed-in organisation; persistence is a real constraint, so the count is real rather than a fixed number (c-148). A notification's category is the one the animals backend stores on its record, an absent one meaning live animals. The Live animals section has no Inspection required card, and cards carry Design Release 2.1's styling (c-156). Blocked as glance cards under Sam's 9 October rulings.
acceptanceCriteria: The Live animals section shows an 'Action needed' glance card reading 'Tasks requiring your attention', with a count and a 'View tasks' link that opens the Action needed drill-down showing only live animals (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:57-62; trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 34; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:43; conflicts:c-250)

A notification whose record carries no category is counted in the Live animals Action needed card (conflicts:c-296)
The Live animals section shows no Inspection required card (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:57-70; trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 30)

When the counts cannot be loaded the home still shows its heading and sections, shows the recoverable error message and responds with HTTP status 500; with Welsh selected the card's copy is shown in Welsh, marked as a machine draft; the home still has no serious or critical axe violations (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-058, p1-079, p1-086)
openQuestions: Blocked: Sam's 9 October rulings block the INS dashboard's summary information, naming this glance card (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-060), until its requirements firm up and are agreed; the area is then re-distilled, settling how the category reaches the INS read model. Who: whoever owns the INS dashboard's requirements (the rulings do not name them) must firm them up and agree them with Sam.
notes: Combines every live-animals glance-card requirement that is not waiting on an outside feed: they share the home template and the card styling. Depends on the home row (sections) and the Action needed page row (the count is that list's total). req-975 also covers the Germinal products section having no Inspection required card, proven in that row.

The category comes from the animals backend's record (c-296); how it reaches the read model is the re-distil's to settle. The live-animals Status updates card (req-974) is held with its blocked drill-down (c-148).

Changes the home's template and copy in the INS dashboard feature folder, which the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns; it builds only after that theme lands (through inc-128), so those files are left out of touches.

increments.title: The live animals list has 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 separates work in flight, unfinished drafts and finished notifications, and DR1 said drafts must not lose their home on the list. The tabs are MoJ sub navigation on the animals frontend's own list, each a link that loads the page, over the animals backend's list, which gains category and tab filters and the 'In progress' count. A notification being amended stays in 'In progress'.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows three tabs, 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed', as MoJ sub navigation, each a link that loads the list with that tab chosen, with or without JavaScript. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-061; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-099, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100)

Opening the list with no tab chosen, or with an unknown tab, shows the 'In progress' tab selected; following a tab link drops any search and sort. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-042; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-036; conflict c-251)

'In progress' lists submitted and action-required notifications, 'Draft' lists drafts, and 'Completed' lists completed notifications, so a draft never appears under 'In progress' and a submitted notification never under 'Draft'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-073, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-075; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-050; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-034)

A notification being amended is listed under 'In progress' with its yellow 'Amending' tag and its Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete actions. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046, repo-frontend-p3-111; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-035, trace-animals-fit-p2-047; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-031; conflict c-165)

Only the 'In progress' tab shows a count, in bold brackets, such as 'In progress (2)', matching the notifications it lists; 'Draft' and 'Completed' show no count, even when selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-043; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-062)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab: 'Notifications in progress', 'Draft notifications' or 'Completed notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-044, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-055, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-057; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-063)

A live animals notification whose record holds no category is still listed on the live animals list under its tab. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-085)
notes: Combines the tab links, membership, amending placement, count, h3 and the list API's category and tab filters: one control over one query.

The tab parameter's name and values are the animals frontend's (c-251). Completed notifications cannot exist until the authorities' outcome feed (req-1082, blocked row), so 'Completed' is proven to hold none of the other statuses. That following a tab also drops the additional filters is proven in the additional-filters row, which adds them.
req-1099's germinal category filter is observed in the germinal rows, once a germinal notification exists; here it is proven by a record with no category staying on the live animals list.
Plants' tabs (req-2034) wait on trade-imports-plants-backend in the blocked plants row.

increments.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 lays the list out in one column and puts search and sort in one form with one submit control. The afternoon ruling makes it one GET form whose icon-only submit button searches and sorts on the server, so it works without JavaScript. Today's search matches only one exact, whole reference, so the search becomes a real keyword search over reference, commodity, consignee and consignor. The sort offers three orderings and is applied for real, with a tie-breaker so paging is stable.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live animals list the search and sort sit in one column above the tabs inside the 'Notifications' section, with no 'Filter notifications' heading and no separate filter column beside the results. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-009, repo-frontend-p3-010; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-013; conflict c-167)

The search field is labelled 'Search by' with the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-039, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-046)

The search is submitted by a real submit button that shows only a magnifying-glass icon and whose accessible name is 'Search'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-047; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097; conflict c-299)

Searching lists every notification whose reference number, commodity, consignee or consignor contains the searched text, ignoring case and surrounding spaces: part of a consignee's name finds that notification, and a lower-case part of a reference finds it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-040; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-022; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-010, repo-backend-p3-011; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-162)

Search and sort are one GET form to the list's own address, submitted by the search button; it keeps the current tab (unless 'In progress') and the current page (when above 1), so the result stays on that tab. Changing the sort select submits nothing by itself, and the list has no 'Update sort' button. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-036; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-058; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-097; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-058; conflict c-299)

The sort select is labelled 'Sort by:' and offers exactly 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', in that order, with no 'Select one' option. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-028; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-046, document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-048; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-026, repo-frontend-p3-027; conflict c-161)

'Newest first' lists the most recently created notification first, 'Oldest first' the earliest created first, and 'Arrival date' the latest arrival date first; with no sort chosen the list is in arrival date order, newest first, with 'Arrival date' selected, and the chosen option stays selected after the page reloads. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-047; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-006, repo-backend-p3-007; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; conflict c-161)

Paging through a sorted list in which several notifications share the sorted date, such as drafts with no arrival date, shows every notification exactly once across the pages. (repo:backend repo-backend-p3-008, repo-backend-p3-009; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-092; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p3-057)

The k6 journey run against the stack still searches the live animals list for its notification by reference and finds the submitted notification's reference, passing every check. (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-068, repo-perftests-p1-069; conflict c-225)

sources.ref: list API search and sort (repo-backend-p3-006 to p3-011)
dashboard search and sort (repo-frontend-p3-009, p3-010, p3-026, p3-027)

notes: Combines the layout, field copy, icon button, real search, one form, sort label, options, real sort, stable paging and no-'Update sort' slices: one form over one query.

The search parameter's name is the animals frontend's. perftests is in repos because the k6 journey searches this list by reference; where this row renames the search parameter it updates the k6 journey in the same change (req-1852 sits in the frame row; c-225).
Already met and kept: the field keeps its text and a blank search lists everything (req-1047). The prototype's inert search and sort (c-162) and its unselected 'Select one' (c-161) are not built.
Plants' search, sort and filters (req-2036) wait on trade-imports-plants-backend in the blocked plants row; plants keeps today's search and sort meanwhile (req-2037).

increments.title: The live animals list has 'Additional filters' for arrival date, date range and status
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 keeps the extra filters out of the way until the trader needs them. The afternoon ruling builds them inside the one GET form from GOV.UK details, radios and a select, with an MoJ date picker at each end of the date range. The prototype's filters are inert, so the real list applies them through the animals backend's list, and a date it cannot use is answered with an error rather than ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Inside the search form the live animals list has an 'Additional filters' disclosure, closed when the list first loads and open whenever an arrival-date, date-range or status filter is set. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-030; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-049; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-054; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101; conflict c-299)

The additional filters have a 'By arrival date' column of small radios 'Today', 'Tomorrow' and 'Next 7 days'; choosing one and searching lists only notifications arriving in that range, and the choice stays checked. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-031; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-055, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-060; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-001; conflict c-162)

The additional filters have a 'By date range' column with the hint 'For example, 27/3/2026' and two MoJ date pickers, 'Start date' and 'End date', each a plain text field without JavaScript; searching lists only notifications arriving between the two dates, and the entered dates are kept. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-051, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-052; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-056, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-121; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102)

With JavaScript, each date picker offers a 'Choose date' calendar that opens on the current month with weeks starting on Monday. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-057; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-101)

Searching with a start date that cannot be read as a date shows a GOV.UK error summary and an inline error 'Enter a real start date'; an unreadable end date shows 'Enter a real end date'; an end date before the start date shows 'End date must be the same as or after the start date'. Each time 'Additional filters' is open, the entered text stays in the pickers, and the list is shown without the date-range filter. (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-102; trace:e2e trace-e2e-p2-047; conflict c-166)

The additional filters have a 'Status' select offering exactly 'Select one', 'Action required', 'Submitted' and 'Completed'; choosing a status and searching lists only notifications in it, and the choice stays selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-035; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-053; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-058; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p2-024)
Following a tab link drops any additional filter as well as the search and sort. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-100)
notes: Combines the disclosure, the three filter columns, the date validation and the list API's status and arrival-date filters: one section of one form over one query. No custom JavaScript: GOV.UK details, radios and select and the MoJ date picker, which the animals frontend already has.

The 'Action required' option lists what the animals backend records as 'Submitted action required' (inc-113); until that lands it lists nothing, and 'Completed' lists nothing until the authorities' outcome feed exists (req-1082, blocked row). Both options render and filter now. The prototype's lack of date validation is overruled (c-166).
Proves the half of req-1058 the tabs row cannot: following a tab drops the filters this row adds.

increments.title: The lists page 8 at a time with numbered pages, and lose the results line and empty messages
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 pages every list 8 at a time with numbered pagination, clamps the page so a stale address never shows an empty list, and shows no results count and no empty-state message. Because the real search and filters apply, page links keep them. Plants' list takes the numbered pagination and loses its results line and empty messages in the same increment; its page size waits on the plants backend.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list shows 8 notifications a page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-005; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092)

A list of more than one page shows GOV.UK pagination with numbered page links, a 'Previous' link from page 2 and a 'Next' link before the last page; a list of one page, or no results, shows no pagination. This holds on the live animals list and on plants' list. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-042; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-033, repo-frontend-p3-035; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-033, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096)

Opening the live animals list at a page number below 1 or not a number shows page 1, and at a page past the last shows the last page; plants' list keeps doing the same. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-041; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-004; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-032-m1; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-035)

On the live animals list every page link keeps the tab (unless 'In progress'), the sort (unless the default), the search text and every additional filter, so page 2 of a filtered list is still filtered. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-031, repo-frontend-p3-034; ruling:sam-2026-10-07 ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-010; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p2-064; conflict c-163)

Neither the live animals list nor plants' list shows a results count: no 'Showing 1 Result', 'Showing S to E of T Results', 'Showing N of T Results' or 'No Results' line. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-044; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-019, repo-frontend-p3-020; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-022, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-023; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-167)

A search or filter that matches nothing shows an empty list with no message, on the live animals list and on plants' list: 'No notifications found' no longer appears. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-021; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-021)

A tab or list with no notifications shows an empty list with no message, on the live animals list and on plants' list: 'You have not started any notifications in this session.' no longer appears, in English or Welsh. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-022, repo-frontend-p3-023; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-038; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-096; conflict c-300)

dashboard pagination and results line (repo-frontend-p3-019 to p3-023, p3-031 to p3-036)
plants dashboard pagination and results line (repo-plantsfrontend-p3-021 to p3-023, p3-033 to p3-035, p3-038)

notes: Combines page size, numbered pagination, out-of-range pages, page links keeping the list's state, and the three removed lines: they all sit below the cards and are proven with the same multi-page set-up. Depends on the search-and-sort and additional-filters rows, since page links carry what they add.

Plants' page size of 8 (req-2035) waits on trade-imports-plants-backend in the blocked plants row; plants' numbered pagination is built on whatever page size the plants backend serves. The prototype's page links dropping the search and filters are overruled (c-163).

increments.title: The live animals list's Summary shows 'Action needed' and 'Status updated' glance cards
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 puts what needs the trader's attention at the top of each category list, with live counts that agree with the drill-down pages. The afternoon ruling counts these Summary cards as the INS dashboard's summary information, blocked until its requirements firm up.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has an h2 'Summary' with two glance cards: 'Action needed' with 'Tasks requiring your attention' and a 'View tasks' link to the action-needed page for the category, and 'Status updated' with 'Changes in the past 24 hours' and a 'View updates' link to the changes page for the category. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-024; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-036 to prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-042 to trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-044)

The 'Action needed' card's count is the number of the category's notifications showing the 'Action required' tag, and matches the list its link opens. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-069; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-031; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-123; conflict c-149)
openQuestions: Blocked: the INS dashboard's requirements must firm up (Sam, 9 October; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-075, p3-078; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates p1-003 to p1-009). Who: Sam and the people the INS dashboard's requirements are agreed with. Once they exist, this summary information is re-distilled, and what the Summary shows, where its counts come from and which drill-downs it links to are decided then.
notes: Nothing in the reframed list depends on this row (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-099). Repos are the animals backend, animals frontend and tests, because the list it sits on stays in the animals frontend; re-check when it is re-distilled. DR2.1's fixed glance numbers are overruled (c-148).

increments.title: The lists' success banner is titled 'Success', on the live animals list and on plants' list
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 uses one success banner titled 'Success'; the message is set by the action that sent the trader back. The 9 October ruling keeps the flag on the redirect, such as after a delete, and the afternoon ruling gives plants' banner the same title. The new wording goes in each list feature's own copy, because the shared notificationActions wording is used by other pages and is never reworded in place.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting a notification, the live animals list shows a GOV.UK success notification banner with role alert, titled 'Success', carrying the delete's message. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-020; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-062, repo-frontend-p3-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-093; conflict c-252)

After deleting a plants notification, plants' list shows the same success banner titled 'Success'. (repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p3-066, repo-plantsfrontend-p3-076; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-071)

The pages that share today's action wording, such as the delete and cancel-amendment pages, still read as they do today: the new 'Success' title is the lists' own wording. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-067, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)

With Welsh chosen, the banner's title shows its Welsh version, marked as a machine draft that ships only once a translator signs it off. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-064, repo-frontend-p3-065; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069)
notes: The banner's message is the action's own: the delete row (inc-126) sets plants' 'Notification has been deleted' (req-2032). Depends on inc-129 and inc-126.

Kept as they are (already met): the banner does not dismiss itself (req-1088, c-006), and the stale-action and 'There is a problem' banners (req-1089). req-1087 (a held, show-once message) is out of scope (c-252): the flag on the redirect stays.
Today's 'Notification copied' banner is never reached, so only the delete is proven.

increments.title: The germinal products set's root renders its own copy of the reframed list
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 gives each category of animal notification its own list. The afternoon ruling builds the germinal list as the germinal set's own copy of the reframed live animals list at the germinal set root in the animals frontend, instead of sending the trader to an INS list. It shows only germinal products notifications, and its 'Create new' starts a germinal notification in the germinal set.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening the germinal products set's root shows its own notification list, not a redirect: the browser title 'Dashboard - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Dashboard' and the h1 'Germinal products'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-021; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; conflict c-314)

The germinal list has the same 'Use template', search, sort, additional filters, tabs, numbered paging and success banner as the live animals list, each submitting to and linking within the germinal list's own address. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-078, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-079, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-081; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-012)

Pressing 'Create new' on the germinal list starts a germinal products notification with status Draft in the germinal products set and lands on that set's first journey page. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-015; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-104; conflict c-251)

The germinal list shows only germinal products notifications: a live animals notification, or one whose record holds no category, never appears on it, and a germinal notification just started appears on it. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-017; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-105)
notes: Copies the live animals list's feature folder into the germinal set, as the germinal set's other pages are copied. The animals backend's category filter is built in the tabs row (inc-135); the category stored on create is inc-176's.

Depends on inc-176 (the germinal set exists and stores its category) and on every live animals list row it copies, now including 'Use template' (inc-196) and the 'Success' banner (inc-140): the germinal list's 'Use template' is the germinal half of req-1038, which sits in inc-196. No Summary: it is blocked with inc-139.
The INS germinal list and its 'Create new' are not built in this programme (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-108); the morning ruling's redirect of the set root to an INS list is overruled (c-314).

increments.title: Cards show the authorities' outcomes: delayed, completed, inspection, their actions and the status-updated count
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 shows on the list what the authorities decide after submission: a delayed notification with its reason, a completed notification in the 'Completed' tab, an inspection warning, and 'Copy as new' and 'View' on cards in those statuses. None of these outcomes reaches the service today, so the row waits on the authorities' case system; the 'Status updated' count also waits on the INS dashboard's requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: A delayed notification shows a 'Delayed' tag on an error card with the reason for the delay, never the prototype's placeholder 'Error message'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-052, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-065)

A notification the authorities have finished with shows the status 'Completed', as plain styled text rather than a tag, and is listed in the 'Completed' tab. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-061; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-068; document:dr1-parity-backlog document-dr1-parity-backlog-p3-032; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

A notification chosen for inspection shows an extra 'Inspection' fact with a 'Required' tag at the end of the card's second row. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-054; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-069)

A card in a delayed or completed status, or action required with no status-driven set of its own, offers 'Copy as new' then 'View', and View opens the notification's review page. increments.title: A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft, stored category, service chrome and origin page, and each set opens only its own notifications
increments.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products (semen, embryos and ova) a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, gateway and set services. Its pages are copies of the finished live-animals feature folders plus the germinal differences, and its overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation are its own copies too. Every live-animal field V4 does not mark animals-only is carried over; the CPH number and the permanent address, which V4 marks animal journey only, are not. This row lays the set down and proves it with its first page: starting a germinal notification creates a Draft with a GBN-AG reference and lands on the germinal set's own copy of the origin page. The germinal set's end-to-end, accessibility and security checks run inside the existing animals Playwright project. Germinal products is a sibling set of live animals and both keep their notifications in the one animals backend, so the stored record must say which set it belongs to. The backend's create takes the category each set sends and stores it at the root of the record, beside its status and reference; nothing after create changes it. A record with no category is read as live animals everywhere, so every notification stored before the germinal set exists stays a live-animals notification without a data migration. A notification holds commodities of its one category only, so changing the type in the journey starts a new notification of the other category and the abandoned draft keeps its own. The read the frontend opens a notification with returns the category, so each set's cross-set guard can refuse the other set's notifications. The category stays on the record only: it is not published on any notification event, the event envelope does not change, and trade-imports-schemas does not change. The field's name and values are the animals backend's to choose in its own conventions. The 9 October ruling has each set pass its category when it creates a draft, so a germinal notification reaches the germinal list and not the live animals list. A record with no category still counts as live animals, so older drafts stay on the live animals list. Sam's 9 October ruling keeps one category per set: a germinal products notification can only be worked in the germinal set, and a live-animals notification only in the live-animals set. Each set's entry guard reads the category recorded on the notification when its draft was created, and a notification with no recorded category is treated as live animals. Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products its own sibling set beside live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products. Every germinal page carries the same chrome as live animals: the 'Import notification service' service navigation with the same items in the same order, the Alpha phase banner, the footer, the GOV.UK title pattern, section captions, back links, error summary and banners. The set-scoped parts resolve inside the germinal set: the service name and the Dashboard item go to /germinal-products, which renders the set's own notification list, Dashboard stays current inside a germinal notification, and an error under /germinal-products shows in the germinal set's chrome. The shared layout already resolves these by the request's mount prefix, so this is proof that the germinal set picks them up, not a shared change.
acceptanceCriteria: Starting a germinal products notification through the germinal set's own start creates a new notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, shown in the status strip from the first page, and lands on the germinal set's 'Origin of the import' page under /germinal-products/notifications/<journeyId>/ using the live-animals slug. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-048; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-055)

Choosing 'Germinal products' on the type question 'What are you importing?' reaches that same germinal start and lands on the germinal origin page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-048, -p1-102; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091)
No germinal products notification is ever given a reference starting GBN-GP. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-028)

increments.title: Germinal Commodity details checks weight and packages, listing errors by question
increments.detail: V4 caps the germinal total gross weight at 1,000 kg to 2 decimal places and above 0, and makes the number of packages mandatory to proceed, a whole number up to 1,000. Design Release 2.1 gives the messages it has; the rest follow the GOV.UK pattern. Valid answers continue as the journey says. Design Release 2.1 orders the Commodity details error summary by question. Ruling 2026-10-09 splits that rule per set: on the germinal-products set every total gross weight error comes before every number of packages error. V4 makes temperature optional, so it raises no error and never appears in the summary.
acceptanceCriteria: A Total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0, shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-008)

A Total gross weight over 1,000, such as 1000.01, shows 'Total gross weight must be 1,000kg or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 is accepted. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-007, -p1-048)

A Total gross weight of 1.5 or 24.50 is accepted; one with more than 2 decimal places, such as 1.555, shows 'Total gross weight must have 2 decimal places or fewer', linked to that species' field and shown inline. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-009, -p1-012; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-041; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

(prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-035, -p3-035-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-015)

A Number of packages that is not a whole number of 1 or more, such as 'x' or 0, shows 'Enter a whole number greater than 0', in the error summary and inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-040; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-037; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-017)

A Number of packages over 1,000 shows 'Number of packages must be 1,000 or less', linked to that species' field and shown inline; 1,000 is accepted. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-014, -p1-016, -p1-018; c-234)

On a germinal-products notification, pressing Save and continue on Commodity details with errors on several species lists every Total gross weight error, species by species, before every Number of packages error, each linking to its own field. increments.title: A germinal products notification chooses its transporter from its own copy of today's transporter step
