increments.title: Germinal products notifications have their own Upload documents page
increments.detail: Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products its own set in the animals frontend, each page a copy of its live-animals feature folder taken after this programme has built the live twin. Upload documents is one of the germinal set's pages: only Additional details, the CPH number and the permanent address are left out. The germinal set gets its own documents page, copied from the live-animals documents feature once the documents rows that can build now have landed, at the same slug within the germinal journey and behaving as every adopted documents requirement says. The Live Animals Germinals Data Fields page (V4) lists no germinal-specific document fields, so the page is the live-animals page unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: On a germinal products notification, the overview's 'Upload documents' task opens a page headed 'Upload documents' with the caption 'Documents', the same guidance, the 'Check which additional documents you must upload' details, the four fields (Document reference, Document type, Date of issue, Attachment) and the same hints and buttons as the live-animals documents page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 3)

On a germinal products notification, a document with the reference 'ITAHC-001', a type, a date of issue and a PDF file is added: it is listed with 'Scanning for virus' and then 'Check completed', its 'View file' link downloads the file, and it is still listed after a reload. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:prototype-dr2-1 TRACE C actions 92-95)

On a germinal products notification, Save and add another with nothing entered shows 'There is a problem' listing 'Enter a document reference', 'Select a document type', 'Enter a date of issue' and 'Upload a document', each inline on its field. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-068)
On a germinal products notification, Remove takes a listed document off the page at once, and it is not listed after a reload. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 2; trace:animals-fit p22-058)

In the germinal products opening run, Save and continue on Upload documents goes to the germinal set's Consignment addresses (roles and addresses) page; opened from the germinal overview, Back and Save and continue return to that overview. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 2, 39)

A document added on a germinal products notification is never listed on a live-animals notification's documents page, and the live-animals set's documents page does not open a germinal products notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 1, 4, 6)
The germinal products documents page has no serious or critical axe violations (WCAG 2.2 AA) when empty, in its error state and with a saved scanned document. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 15)
notes: Must come after every live-animals documents row that can build now (inc-031 to inc-035), so the copy carries their changes, and after the germinal set's own rows: the set and its mount, its overview, its step order and return rules, and category scoping (inc-176 today; the combiner adds the others by their ids). The blocked 50MB row (inc-036) is not waited on; when it unblocks it changes both sets' pages. Keeps its theme, germinal-products.

Its end-to-end, accessibility and security specs sit under the tests repo's animals project in the germinal-products folders; the security spec drives the germinal documents routes through the ZAP scan. increments.title: The INS address book takes adds from germinal products notifications and returns to them
increments.detail: A trader adding an address from a germinal products notification's party picker crosses to the INS address book by the same handshake and the same add page as from live animals, with the same address record and rules. The INS address book accepts the germinal products set as well as live animals and, on save or cancel, returns to the germinal set's own address-return page for that notification, built on the server from a registered entry in the INS service's conventions. INS-side germinal work stays in the INS themes and is proven in the ins Playwright project (ruling 2026-10-09 claim 61). Observable in the INS frontend's fit suite, on the compose stack and in CDP, as the redirect the INS frontend sends.
acceptanceCriteria: The INS address book's add page accepts a handshake from the germinal products set, as it accepts one from live animals, and shows the same add page (repo:frontend p9-134; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-006, p1-061)

Saving or cancelling an add begun from a germinal products notification sends the trader to the germinal set's address-return page for that notification, under /germinal-products/notifications/{notification id}, and never to a live-animals notification (repo:frontend p9-134, p9-139; trace:e2e p9-014, p9-070; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-009, p1-011)

increments.title: Germinal products roles and addresses page and party pickers, with no CPH number or permanent address page
increments.detail: Gives the germinal products set its own roles and addresses page and its own five party pickers, copied from the live-animals addresses feature once this area's rows have built it, as ruling sam-2026-10-09 directs (germinal products is a sibling set of duplicated feature pages). The copy behaves as the live-animals page and pickers do, with the same words and hints, except that a germinal consignment is only ever asked for the five consignment addresses: the set has no CPH number and no permanent address section, and serves no CPH number or permanent address page. A trader importing germinal products can then record every party of the consignment within the germinal notification. Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are not pets, so the germinal products set, copied from the live-animals addresses feature, must leave out the CPH number and permanent address sections and pages the live set has. On a germinal products notification, section 'Consignment parties' of the Overview holds the single row 'Roles and addresses' with the same hint as live animals. The germinal set has no CPH number or permanent address page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 3), so the row reads 'Complete' once the consignment addresses are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: From a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Roles and addresses' task opens a 'Consignment addresses' page with the caption 'Consignment parties', the paragraph 'Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment.' and the warning 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud', within that germinal products notification (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122)

For every germinal commodity the page shows exactly five sections, in this order: Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination; it shows no CPH number section and no 'Permanent address' section (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

The germinal products set offers no CPH number page and no permanent address page: nothing on its pages links to one, and opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows 'Page not found' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

The germinal products set never asks what the goods are certified for: a draft is created with 'Germinal products' already stored, published as the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause like any other certified-for answer, and read back on the review with no Change link.

increments.title: Germinal products templates are answered on the germinal set's pages, and the germinal origin page's Back link follows where the notification started
increments.detail: Template creation offers Germinal products alongside Live animals, because templates carry their type and the animals backend stores both. A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own question pages in template mode: the same template mode the live-animals pages get, applied to the germinal pages, never a copied template journey. So a germinal template has no Additional details task and asks no CPH number or permanent address. It is saved, listed with the category 'Germinal products', viewed, changed and deleted like any template. Using it starts a germinal products notification in the germinal set, seeded only with the answers that fit that set: the main reason for import, the purpose in the internal market when the reason is 'Internal market', and the storage temperature when it is one of the germinal temperature options. 'Certified for' is the germinal set's fixed 'Germinal products', and nothing about unweaned animals is asked or seeded. In the germinal products set, the origin page's Back link goes to the notification type question when the notification was started from it, to the germinal products set's own notifications list when started from that list, to the notification overview when opened from the overview, and to the template review when a germinal products template is being edited. This is the germinal half of the origin Back link: the 9 October ruling splits req-013 by set, and the live-animals half went with the split-off type-question-and-templates theme.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos) on the type question in template creation, then naming the template, opens the germinal set's first question page in template mode, with the 'Template' caption and the template's name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 6, 16, 127; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 26-30; c-265)

increments.title: Waiting on design: a Search button beside the country of origin, port of entry, transit country and place of landing searches
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 gives its type-aheads a separate Search button. When design answers, it is built as design says, in the animals port of entry and transit country searches and the plants place of landing search, or dropped if design drops it. Design Release 2.1 presents the country of origin control as a search box with its own button. The 9 October afternoon ruling makes this a JavaScript-era mechanic beyond the component's own options, so it waits on design question 1, as one waiting-on-design increment shared with the port of entry and transit country boxes. If design asks for it, the box gains a separate 'Search' button on the origin page of both animals sets and of plants; if design drops it, this row is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, the port of entry search and the transit country search each have a search button beside the box whose accessible name is 'Search' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-026, prototype-dr2-1-source-p6-070; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-013, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p8-053)

Without JavaScript, the three questions are still labelled native selects that choose and save an answer, with no search button (conflict c-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p11-103)

With JavaScript, the live-animals and plants origin pages' country boxes each have a separate button at their right, showing a search icon with the visually hidden text 'Search' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-032; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-031; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-014, p1-055, p3-032; conflicts:c-009)

increments.title: Once commodities come from MDM, the germinal catalogue holds V4's 18 items, with embryos and ova separate and each its own GBN-AG type
increments.detail: V4 sets which germinal commodities the data applies to, and the GBN-AG schema has separate EMBRYO and OVA codes, so embryos and ova become separate items. The 9 October afternoon ruling makes this catalogue wait until commodities come from MDM and the germinal catalogue is re-distilled from that list. When it lands, the germinal catalogue holds V4's 18 items, each offering the species Design Release 2.1 lists, selections show as the live-animal search shows them, and each germinal trade line on GBN-AG carries the code for its own product type.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal catalogue holds 18 items, sorted by name, codes shown with their leading zero: Cattle, Goat, Horse, Pig and Sheep each as '<Animal>, Embryos' and '<Animal>, Ova' (05119985); 'Cattle, Semen' (05111000); and 'Cat, Semen', 'Dog, Semen', 'Goat, Semen', 'Horse, Semen', 'Pig, Semen', 'Rabbit/Rodent, Semen' and 'Sheep, Semen' (05119985). There are no Cat or Dog embryos or ova and no poultry, fish or bee germinal products. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-002, -p1-049 to -p1-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036 to -p1-038; c-229, c-230)

Each germinal item offers the species Design Release 2.1 lists for its animal: Cattle offers Bison bison, Bos taurus and Bubalus bubalis, with Bovidae as well for semen; Horse offers Equus asinus and Equus caballus; Goat Capra hircus; Pig Sus scrofa domesticus; Sheep Ovis aries; Cat Felis catus; Dog Canis familiaris; and Rabbit/Rodent, Semen one row labelled Rabbit/Rodent. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-138, -p2-141 to -p2-143, -p2-145 to -p2-155-m1, -p3-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-061, -p3-062, -p3-076)

Ticking Domestic cattle (Bos taurus) under Cattle, Semen shows '1 selected' with a 'Cattle, Semen (05111000):' line and a 'Bos taurus' chip, as the live-animal search does. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-063; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-009)

In the published GBN-AG payload each germinal trade line carries the typeCode SEMEN for a semen item, EMBRYO for an embryos item and OVA for an ova item, and embryos and ova are always separate trade lines, never one 'Embryos/Ova' line. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-036 to -p1-039; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-029; c-273)

Until then the germinal set offers today's 12 germinal lines (req-1927) with interim typeCodes (req-1928).
notes: Combines V4's catalogue (req-093), its selection panel (req-1783) and the separate EMBRYO and OVA trade lines (req-1800): all three wait on the same MDM catalogue and change once it lands.
c-230 is ruled (V4's 12 commodities with embryos and ova split and Cat and Dog semen separate: 18 items, no Cat or Dog embryos or ova), so its former open question becomes this note.

increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 renders the germinal collection and production dates with the MoJ date picker's 'Choose date' calendar. This row builds what design answers, enhancing the text inputs built now, or is dropped.
acceptanceCriteria: If design keeps the calendar: each germinal date field has a 'Choose date' toggle opening a month grid with previous and next year and month buttons, 'Select' and 'Close', and picking a day fills that date's text input; without JavaScript the text input works as before. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-092; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-064)
openQuestions: Waits on design's answer to design question 12 (germinal dates): whether the MoJ date picker's calendar stays, or a plain date field or the GOV.UK date input will do instead. Built as design says; if design answers a plain date field, nothing changes and the row is dropped.
notes: Belongs in the waiting-on-design theme, as inc-192 does today, and depends on inc-053, whose no-JavaScript text inputs it builds on (c-283).

increments.detail: With JavaScript, the address book list re-requests itself as the user types in the search field or changes the Type select, debounced, and swaps in the table, the results line and the pagination without a full page load, enhancing the GET form that already works without JavaScript. Built as design answers design question 5 (live filtering), or dropped if design drops it. It sits in one waiting-on-design increment with the party pickers' live row filter. With JavaScript, narrows a party picker's list as the trader types, with no page reload, on both animals sets' pickers and the high-risk plants frontend's consignor and place of destination pickers, as DR1 and Design Release 2.1 both wanted. It waits on design: until design, with the product owner, answers design question 5, the server search behind the submit button is the whole search. It is built as design answers, or dropped if design drops it.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript on, typing in the search field or changing the Type select, after a short pause, updates the table, the results line and the pagination to the matches without a full page load, and no apply button is needed. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-067; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p16-026, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p16-027)

increments.title: Waiting on design: address search's search-only layout, results as the trader types, reveal on a pick and its announcements, in the address book and the commercial transporter form
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 opens Destination, Consignee or Importer and Branch addresses on the address search alone, lists matches as the user types, and reveals the address fields once a result is picked or 'Enter address manually' is chosen. This is JavaScript-only behaviour, so Sam's 9 October afternoon ruling holds it as one waiting-on-design increment: design is asked (question 10) whether the GOV.UK address pattern with the fields always visible will do. It is also blocked on the address lookup becoming a real feature. If design keeps it, it is built on top of the no-JavaScript search, which keeps working without JavaScript. Design Release 2.1's search pages show only the search at first: the address fields and the uses checkboxes appear once a result is picked or the trader chooses 'Enter address manually', the search hides after a pick, results appear as the trader types with the match in bold, and screen readers hear how many results there are. The 9 October afternoon ruling (c-287) holds these back as one waiting-on-design increment: design question 10 asks whether address search keeps this search-only layout or uses the GOV.UK address pattern with the fields always visible, and question 5 asks about filtering as the trader types. They also wait on the address lookup, like the rest of address search (c-217). If design keeps them, they are built on top of the no-JavaScript search, which keeps working without JavaScript. Design Release 2.1 starts the commercial transporter form, with JavaScript, showing only the address search and an 'Enter address manually' button, revealing the address and contact fields on a pick, on manual entry, or when they hold a value or an error. This is a JavaScript enhancement of the no-JavaScript search, built only if design keeps it under design question 10, with the address book's search-only layout. Blocked three ways: design question 10, the address lookup becoming a real feature, and transporter requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript on, for 'Destination, Consignee or Importer' and 'Branch' the add-details step opens with only the address search; the address fields, contact fields and uses question stay hidden until an address is picked or manual entry is chosen, and open already revealed when an address or address line 1 is already present (prototype:dr2-1-source p16-025, p16-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p16-083, p16-096, p16-098; prototype:dr2-1-specs p6-140, p6-141)

Typing in the address search lists matching addresses below it in a list labelled 'Address search results', each shown as the lookup's formatted address line with the typed text in bold, and a screen-reader announcement gives the number of results, such as '1 result available' (prototype:dr2-1-source p16-027, p16-029, p16-030; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p16-086, p16-086-m1; prototype:dr2-1-specs p6-143; c-178)
Below the address search an 'Enter address manually' link-styled button reveals the address and contact fields (prototype:dr2-1-source p16-036; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p16-085, p16-130)

Saving the search-only layout with nothing picked or typed shows the six field errors with the address and contact fields revealed, so each error summary link moves to a visible field; the errors stay until the next save, and the typed values, ticked uses and search text are kept (prototype:dr2-1-source p16-077; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p16-092, p16-094; prototype:dr2-1-specs p6-142; repo:insfrontend p3-065; c-180)

Picking a search result hides the search, reveals the address and contact fields and announces 'Selected <name>' to screen readers (prototype:dr2-1-source p16-033, p16-034; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p16-087; c-305)
With JavaScript off, the page behaves as the no-JavaScript search does: the fields are shown and the search button searches on the server (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-086, p1-087; c-305)
Below the address search, an 'Enter address manually' link-styled button reveals the address and contact fields without picking a result (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-088; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-045)

On the search pages the address fields and the 'What else should this address be used for?' checkboxes stay hidden until the trader picks a result or chooses to enter the address manually, the search box hides once a result is picked, and the fields show again after a failed submit when anything was entered or picked (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-089, p8-091; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-042-m1, p7-048; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-070)

Submitting a search page before picking or entering anything shows, in order, 'Enter a name or organisation name', 'Enter address line 1', 'Enter a town or city', 'Enter a postcode or Zip code', 'Enter an email address', 'Enter a phone number', with no country error and no error of the search's own, and reveals the fields so each error summary link reaches a visible field (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-099; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-051; prototype:dr2-1-specs p3-071; conflicts:c-109)
Screen readers hear the result count through a polite live region, such as '1 result available' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-047; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-027)

With JavaScript, address search results appear as the trader types, with the typed text in bold in each result (prototype:dr2-1-source p8-086; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p7-046; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-017, p1-061)
With JavaScript off, the page behaves as the no-JavaScript search does: the fields are shown and the Search button searches on the server (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p1-090; conflicts:c-287)

In the fit suites and on the local stack, with JavaScript, the commercial transporter form's address fields and 'Enter contact details' section start hidden behind the address search and an 'Enter address manually' link-style button that reveals them; they already show when an address has been looked up, when address line 1 has a value, when an address field has an error or after any failed save, keeping the search text and the picked address. increments.title: Waiting on design: the amend and cancel-amendment pop-ups
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 opens the amend and cancel-amendment confirmations as modal dialogs over the current page. GOV.UK Frontend has no modal, the Ministry of Justice's Modal dialog is not accepted (Experimental, no documented fallback without JavaScript), and no increment writes custom JavaScript to copy the prototype. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the confirmations now as pages carrying the pop-ups' wording, and holds the pop-ups themselves as one waiting-on-design increment for both animals sets and plants, blocked on design question 9. The expected answer is that they are not built, and the increment is then dropped; it is built only if design makes a strong case, as design then says.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, 'Amend this notification' and 'Cancel amend' open their confirmations as modal dialogs over the current page instead of going to the confirmation pages, each hidden until opened, announced as a modal dialog named by its heading (the amend dialog also described by its question), with a Close (X) button announced as 'Close' and an overlay (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-029, prototype-dr2-1-source-p1-030, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-050; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-183, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-060, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-061)

Close, the overlay and the dialog's 'No, go back' or 'Go back' dismiss it without acting and leave the trader where they were (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-054, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-055; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-084)
With JavaScript turned off, the same controls still reach the amend and cancel-amendment confirmation pages and work as before (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-088)
The same dialogs and fallbacks apply in the high-risk plants frontend (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-088)
openQuestions: Design question 9 (design must answer): are the amend and cancel-amendment pop-ups built at all, and if so with which tested component? Expected answer: not built, and this increment is dropped. Built only if design makes a strong case; MoJ's Modal dialog is not accepted (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 7 and 19).
notes: Unchanged by this re-distil: req-1393 still carries blockedBy design question 9, so the row stays blocked. Depends on the amend confirmation row (inc-120), the cancel-amendment row (inc-121), the Amend status bar row (inc-122) and the germinal row (inc-185), whose no-JavaScript pages it would enhance. Changes plants too when built. Keep its waiting-on-design theme.

increments.title: A 'Submitted action required' notification can be amended, copied and deleted as a Submitted one can
increments.detail: The 9 October afternoon ruling adds 'Submitted action required' beside the other statuses without changing them, and Design Release 2.1 offers Amend this notification, Copy as new and Delete on an action-required notification exactly as on a Submitted one. Every action that accepts a Submitted notification today must accept this status too, or the trader is refused on the very notification that needs their action. Cancelling its amendment restores its submitted answers and so its status, and resubmitting records whatever status the outstanding items give at that moment. Animals sets only: plants has no action-required status.
acceptanceCriteria: On a 'Submitted action required' notification's view, 'Amend this notification' and the amend confirmation open its amendment, as they do for a Submitted one. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-008, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-096; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

Cancelling that amendment returns the trader to the notification's view showing 'Submitted action required' and its submitted answers, unchanged. (prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-134; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

Resubmitting the amendment with an ITAHC or health certificate now uploaded and nothing else outstanding shows the notification as 'Submitted'; resubmitting it with items still outstanding shows 'Submitted action required'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-096; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-071)

'Copy as new' on a 'Submitted action required' notification makes a new draft carrying over the same answers Copy as new carries from a Submitted one. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-134)

'Delete' on a 'Submitted action required' notification removes it from the set's own list with the deletion banner, and the backend publishes a NotificationSubmissionDeleted event for it. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-012; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070)
notes: New row for req-2113, which the cross-area pass wrote and no area drafted. Kept apart from inc-120, inc-121, inc-123 and inc-125: those change the actions' pages for every status and build now, while this row needs inc-113's recorded 'Submitted action required' status first.

Design Release 2.1 never traces amending an action-required notification (trace-prototype-dr2-1-p14-121); the behaviour follows from its status resting on the outstanding items. The status guards sit in the animals backend's notification service, which the overview-and-review theme also changes; this theme lands after it.
